name: git-new-vs-committed
criterio: Mathias, 2026-10-14: with the sidebar open an agent makes two files, runs git init and commits one; the sidebar must tell them apart as git does (the untracked one says U, the committed one carries no mark), not a + on both. With hidden files shown, the tree lists .env but never .git, as herdr-sidebar (tree.rs: .git is always hidden)
cmd: P="${TUIQA_HOME}/proj"; g() { GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null git -C "$P" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; }; ( sleep 1.5; echo uno > "$P/archivo1.txt"; echo dos > "$P/archivo2.txt"; echo x > "$P/.env"; sleep 0.5; g init -q -b main && g add archivo1.txt && g commit -q -m one ) & exec "${LAZYFINDER_BIN}" --sidebar "$P"

steps.desc: the untracked file says U, as git status does
the committed file carries neither a + nor a letter
git init made .git, and the tree still does not list it
